scientific_integrity: Classical building and orbit-space results are identified as premises; first homology and rational higher homology only, no unproved integral extrapolation. Unindexed equivalent work remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: The calculation concerns ordinary geometric quotients, not homotopy orbit spaces.
No claim on higher integral homology or full homotopy types.
title: Cyclotomic stabilizers and rational homology of all Singer-subgroup quotients of finite spherical buildings
